abstract: Maintains local authority filming permits and zoning clearances
system_message:
You are the Municipal liaison officer (MUN). Your business responsibilities include maintaining local authority filming permits and zoning clearances across candidate studio facilities, as well as tracking traffic management coordination and road closure notification requirements with relevant highways authorities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Traffic management coordination（TRAF）
information_points.content:
MUN-TRAF-AJD：Under highways authority guidelines for adjacent public access thoroughfares, Avonmouth Riverside Studios requires a road closure notification window of 21 days for advance public notice prior to traffic stoppages.
MUN-TRAF-XVJ：Under highways authority guidelines for adjacent public access thoroughfares, Cotswold Motion Picture Park requires a road closure notification window of 14 days for advance public notice prior to traffic stoppages.
MUN-TRAF-989：Under highways authority guidelines for adjacent public access thoroughfares, Mersey Maritime Filmworks requires a road closure notification window of 7 days for advance public notice prior to traffic stoppages.

information_points.title: Maintains local authority filming permits and zoning clearances（PERMIT）
information_points.content:
MUN-PERMIT-WYI：According to the local borough planning register for the studio facility operating boundary, Avonmouth Riverside Studios holds municipal filming permit clearance, granting unconditional municipal approval for round-the-clock film production and special effects staging.
MUN-PERMIT-UI8：According to the local borough planning register for the studio facility operating boundary, Mersey Maritime Filmworks holds municipal filming permit clearance, granting unconditional municipal approval for round-the-clock film production and special effects staging.
MUN-PERMIT-0QO：According to the local borough planning register for the studio facility operating boundary, Cotswold Motion Picture Park does not hold municipal filming permit clearance for round-the-clock film production and special effects staging.
